results.name: Nicolo Bakery
results.summary: Chill vibes define Nicolo Bakery, a pet-friendly shophouse nestled between Ekkamai and Phra Khanong. Offering a delectable range of fresh breads and sweet treats like moist brownies and Petite Madeleines at wallet-friendly prices, this stylish space is perfect for morning relaxation. Ideal for dog walkers or anyone seeking a cozy spot to unwind, Nicolo Bakery promises a delightful experience.

results.name: Mivana Organic Forest Coffee
results.summary: Mivana Organic Forest Coffee offers a serene escape within Bangkok's lush greenery, perfect for nature lovers and coffee enthusiasts alike. Sip on their delightful Thai-style iced coffee while surrounded by towering trees and vines, creating a picturesque setting ideal for photography. Open daily from 7:30 am to 6:30 pm, this chill cafe invites guests to disconnect and unwind in a tranquil atmosphere.

results.name: Haze Bar
results.summary: Haze Bar offers a chill atmosphere for craft beer enthusiasts, showcasing rotating taps and a variety of imports. Knowledgeable staff guide patrons through an impressive selection of styles, from hazy IPAs to rich stouts. Ideal for those exploring the vibrant Ari and north Sukhumvit area, this bar frequently hosts exciting pop-ups and tap takeovers.

results.name: Good Roots
results.summary: Good Roots in Sukhumvit offers a unique dining experience with its focus on functional, nutrient-dense meals crafted from locally sourced ingredients. Signature dishes like Miso Yuzu Salmon highlight the restaurant's commitment to flavor and health, catering especially to the health-conscious diner. Open daily, this chill cafe invites guests to savor delicious food while feeling good about their choices.

results.name: Onedee Café
results.summary: Onedee Café in Ari offers a fresh take on Thai desserts with innovative ice-cream flavors that blend traditional tastes. Standout offerings include a salty-sweet coconut cream ice-cream and khanom tarn ice-cream, both capturing the essence of classic Thai treats. The café's chill vibe complements its adventurous menu, making it a favorite among locals and visitors alike.
